title: Bmlebocin3 could inhibit Bombyx mori cytoplasmic polyhedrosis virus in silkworms via the immune deficiency pathway and through the 20-hydroxyecdysone modulations.
authors: Awais, Mian Muhammad; Mehmood, Nasir; Yu, Wensheng; Sun, Jingchen; Bian, Haixu; Yan, Huichao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究家蚕抗菌肽BmLEB3的抗病毒功能及IMD通路和20E调控，仅含分子对接预测20E与BmPGRP-S1的潜在互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作核心体系，方法浅层且无TF-DNA结合建模。
abstract: Antimicrobial peptides (AMPs) are critical components of the innate immune system in insects, but their regulation and contribution to antiviral defence remain poorly understood. In this study, we investigated the expression, antiviral activity and regulation of Bombyx mori Lebocin-3 (BmLEB3) during infection with Bombyx mori cytoplasmic polyhedrosis virus (BmCPV). BmLEB3 expression was markedly induced following BmCPV infection in the silkworms. RNAi-mediated knockdown of BmLEB3 increased the transcriptional level of viral marker gene vp1 in BmN cells, whereas overexpression led to the inhibition of viral replication in BmN cells. Mechanistically, BmCPV induced the expression of the pattern-recognition receptor BmPGRP-S1 and the transcription factor BmRelish, and silencing of either gene reduced BmLEB3 expression, suggesting that immune deficiency (IMD)-associated signalling contributes to BmLEB3 regulation. Moreover, BmLEB3 was induced by 20-hydroxyecdysone (20E) treatment, further strengthening its antiviral effect. Molecular docking analysis revealed a potential interaction between 20E and BmPGRP-S1, indicating a possible hormonal modulation of IMD-associated AMP expression. Collectively, our results identify BmLEB3 as a virus-responsive AMP and suggest that its expression is modulated by IMD-associated signalling and hormonal cues during BmCPV infection in B. mori. These findings provide insight into the molecular regulation of antiviral immune responses in the silkworm and provide a basis for improving disease resistance in sericulture against microbial pathogens.
abstract_zh: 抗菌肽（AMPs）是昆虫先天免疫系统中的关键组分，但其调控机制及在抗病毒防御中的作用仍知之甚少。本研究探讨了家蚕（Bombyx mori）Lebocin-3（BmLEB3）在家蚕细胞质多角体病毒（BmCPV）感染过程中的表达、抗病毒活性及其调控机制。BmCPV感染后，家蚕中BmLEB3的表达显著诱导上调。通过RNAi介导的BmLEB3敲低，增加了BmN细胞中病毒标记基因vp1的转录水平，而BmLEB3过表达则抑制了BmN细胞中的病毒复制。机制上，BmCPV诱导了模式识别受体BmPGRP-S1和转录因子BmRelish的表达，且沉默任一基因均降低了BmLEB3的表达，表明免疫缺陷（IMD）相关信号通路参与BmLEB3的调控。此外，20-羟基蜕皮酮（20E）处理可诱导BmLEB3表达，进一步增强其抗病毒效果。分子对接分析揭示了20E与BmPGRP-S1之间的潜在相互作用，提示激素可能调节IMD相关AMP的表达。综合来看，我们的结果将BmLEB3鉴定为一种病毒响应性AMP，并表明其表达在BmCPV感染家蚕过程中受IMD相关信号通路和激素信号的调控。这些发现为家蚕抗病毒免疫反应的分子调控提供了见解，并为蚕业中提高对微生物病原体的抗病性奠定了基础。
